stem: When prices rise because overall demand for goods and services in the economy exceeds available supply (e.g., too much money chasing too few goods), this type of inflation is called:
explanation: Demand-pull inflation arises when aggregate demand outstrips supply — distinct from cost-push inflation, which occurs when rising production costs (e.g., wages, raw materials) force producers to raise prices even without a demand increase.
